liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Drums** (1 review): The band is in rhythm devils mode during this extended jam [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-04-22.145140.fob.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 223 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1979-04-22.148569.sbd.composite.clugston.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 208 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd79-04-22.sbd.bennett.12001.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 206 min; rated 3.81/5 by 62 [6]. Said about its sound: The transition into Fire On The Mountain is described as tremendous; Instruments come through well despite some hissing, with Weir playing slide; Jerry takes the controls on a tight performance of this song [19][21]
- **gd1979-04-22..s2.sbd.munder.9424.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 132 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [8]. Said about its sound: Minor right channel static is present throughout the first disc [8]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Bill Graham [1]
- It rained during the performance of this song at the stadium [15]
- The reviewer's friend, a recent military veteran, bought tickets for the show [15]
- Audience members recognized the new bassist from a previous Bob Weir Band gig [16]
- Mickey gets a hot mention for his vibraphone playing in the background [23]
- Charlie Daniels and the Greg Kihn Band were the other artists [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-04-22.145140.fob.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB)Audience Cassette ; Sony ECM-270 mics (DFC, split, mounted on poles 5' apart, 20' in front of soundboard) > Sony TC-158SD (2 x… [1]. Also: Mark Severson provided the master cassettes for the recording; Charlie Miller handled the transfer and coordinated the release effort [1]
- **gd1979-04-22.148569.sbd.composite.clugston.flac16**: transferred by Composite by Scott Clugston; source: composite of 3 sources, compiled, patched and tweeked to represent the best available sources (imo) as of 12/19 [5]. Also: The second set source was pitch and channel corrected for accuracy [5]
- **gd79-04-22.sbd.bennett.12001.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]
- **gd1979-04-22..s2.sbd.munder.9424.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Willy Munder; source: SBD>MR>??>DAT>CDR [8]
